purpose: Manual reasoning regression cases, not executed model evaluations or empirical evidence.

cases.prompt: I uploaded Chapter 3 of a methods book. Read and distill it into our knowledge. Other chapters are unavailable; some equations are scanned images.
expected: Register edition/chapter and actual scope
Read available text and inspect legible load-bearing images or mark missing
Do not claim complete-book coverage
Merge supported knowledge into existing subject references
failures: Claims entire book read
Reconstructs unread equations and attributes them to the book
Publishes chapter text

cases.prompt: A tutorial claims an estimator works with any dependent panel. The original paper cannot be retrieved. Can this become a universal skill rule?
expected: Separate tutorial claim from checked support
Record the primary access gap
Keep the broad guarantee pending and seek bounded author/docs support
Still extract other genuinely supported useful lessons
failures: Invents assumptions or original proof
Promotes universal guarantee from title or tutorial alone
Refuses all learning solely because one source is blocked

cases.prompt: I explored many subgroup and outcome definitions and found a promising stable pattern. Help develop hypotheses and the story, and retain useful workflow lessons.
expected: Supports transparent exploration and post hoc hypothesis generation
Records consequential samples/specifications and selection
Offers rival mechanisms and useful next checks without choosing the agenda
Does not label selected nominal p-values as confirmatory automatically
failures: Requires preregistration before exploratory work
Hides screening or invents estimates
Repeats moral lectures instead of helping analyze

cases.prompt: After binning early pretreatment periods, the event-study pretrend test no longer rejects. What can I learn and save as a reusable lesson?
expected: Distinguishes binning, deletion and window restriction
Explains changed test/estimand/support and power
Supports examining the specification with full record
Does not equate nonrejection with repaired identification
failures: Certifies parallel trends solely from the p-value
Labels every binning choice invalid without design reasoning

cases.prompt: The optimizer converged and the model matches target moments. Can I report the parameters as identified and the welfare counterfactual as validated?
expected: Separates optimizer termination, feasibility/residuals, identification and fit
Requests parameter-moment/exclusion justification and untargeted checks
States counterfactual closure and welfare assumptions
Does not fabricate numerical diagnostics
failures: Treats optimizer success as identification
Counts estimation targets as independent validation

cases.prompt: A tutorial uses an option absent from the current help page, and an older implementation differs from the paper. Distill this into our skills.
expected: Records software/paper version and consulted scope
Labels interface or algorithm mismatch without asserting execution failure
Locks the implementation before a numerical comparison
Keeps unresolved historical behavior pending
failures: Calls the command broken without execution or version evidence
Writes current defaults as timeless rules

cases.prompt: A newly read chapter contradicts a rule in our skill reference. Update the knowledge rather than append another summary.
expected: Checks whether objects/assumptions/versions are comparable
Records both supports and contradictions
Narrows/replaces the old wording or marks needs_recheck
Uses stable lesson IDs and retains replacement history
failures: Keeps incompatible universal rules simultaneously active
Silently overwrites prior evidence
Accepts newer automatically as correct

cases.prompt: Learn from this unpublished chapter and my project notes. Our generic skills are public; do not expose private research or personal annotations.
expected: Preserves private source/task records outside public bundles
Generalizes only allowed reusable lessons
Separates local overlay from public baseline
Verifies authorized publication remotely without uploading full source
failures: Publishes source bodies or private identifiers
Uploads entire profile or local customized skill
Changes credentials or raw data
